```yaml
name: Push Manifests to OCI Registry

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - 'main'
    paths:
      - 'overlays/x86/**'

jobs:
  push-manifests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Setup kubectl
        uses: azure/setup-kubectl@v3

      - name: Setup kustomize
        uses: imranismail/setup-kustomize@v1
        with:
          kustomize-version: v4.5.7

      - name: Login to GHCR
        uses: docker/login-action@v2
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Build and push manifests
        run: |
          # Build the manifests using kustomize
          kustomize build overlays/x86 > manifests.yaml
          
          # Tag and push to GHCR as OCI artifact
          IMAGE_NAME="ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}/manifests-x86"
          TAG="${{ github.sha }}"
          
          # Push the manifest file as an OCI artifact
          echo "Pushing manifests to $IMAGE_NAME:$TAG"
          echo "Manifest content:"
          cat manifests.yaml
          
          # Use crane to push the manifest as an OCI artifact
          # First install crane
          go install github.com/google/go-containerregistry/cmd/crane@latest
          
          # Create a temporary directory for our manifest
          mkdir -p /tmp/manifests
          cp manifests.yaml /tmp/manifests/
          
          # Push the directory as an OCI artifact
          crane push /tmp/manifests "$IMAGE_NAME:$TAG"
          
          # Also push with a version tag if this is a tagged release
          REF="${{ github.ref }}"
          if [ -n "$REF" ] && [[ "$REF" == refs/tags/* ]]; then
            TAG_NAME="${REF#refs/tags/}"
            crane push /tmp/manifests "$IMAGE_NAME:$TAG_NAME"
          fi
```
